📖 How to use

  1. Add each course with grade and credit hours.
  2. Click Calculate GPA.
  3. See GPA, total credits and quality points.
  4. Edit by deleting and re-adding a course.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I calculate my GPA?

Add each course with its name, letter grade and credit hours, then click Calculate GPA.

Are plus/minus grades supported?

Yes — A+ through F including all +/- variants, mapped to the standard 4.0 scale (A = 4.0, A- = 3.7, B+ = 3.3, etc.).

How is the GPA computed?

GPA = Σ (grade points × credits) ÷ Σ credits. Courses with more credits weigh more.

Is my course list saved?

Yes — courses are stored in this browser's localStorage.
